posts.author: Frankerlin
posts.body:
Hi All,
It's a pleasure to return to the RPG Maker community.
So, to be brief, I've been using RPG Maker XP since I was a teenager. A friend from that time introduced me to the software and I was hooked from the getgo. So many fond memories of creating fictional worlds and characters - it was like a dream come true. And, in many ways, it still is.
The years have gone by and I'm now in my early thirties. When I saw RPG Maker XP on sale for a few bucks on Steam, I had to buy it. I thought it would be nice as a hobby and side-project to undergo on the side, when not working in my full-time job.
I'm currently working on a game (working title 'AltWorld') revolving around regular people in a VRMMO. I'm using it as a means of refamiliarizing myself with the features RPG Maker XP while having fun at the same time. I hope to get the latest version, RPG Maker MZ sometime this year.
I look forward to checking out everyone's projects and discussing everything RPG Maker-related!

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
Welcome to the forum and welcome back to RPG Maker!
Having only discovered RPG Maker about 3 years ago (yes, I am old and was apparently living under a rock for about 3 decades), I am always a little jealous of folks who started their journey at a much younger age. I can only image all the fun I would have had making games when I was a teenager.
Anyway, you can always make up for lost time.
Good luck on your projects and just remember to always try to enjoy what you do! If it is a hobby and you aren't mostly enjoying it, then why do it, right?
